newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end lower; Nasdaq snaps winning streak.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end lower; Nasdaq snaps winning streak.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed lower Thursday as investors took profits after the previous day's rally pushed the Dow Jones industrial average above 8,000 points for the first time ever.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended off 18.11 points to close at 8,020.77. The Nasdaq index lost 11.65 points to end at 1,568.98, its first lower finish after 10 straight record highs.
In the broader market, declining issues led advances 15-12 on heavy volume of 633 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
